verdict.rationale: Otter ships a Public API, MCP server and webhooks, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this product. The help-center documentation of the Public API explicitly states there is no sandbox, and nothing in the evidence describes a test workspace or any isolation from production meeting data. OAuth permissions that limit which meetings an AI assistant can access are an adjacent access control, not a sandbox environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
